covered_report_window: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the U.S. market close on Thursday, October 8, 2026, plus companies reporting before the U.S. market open on Friday, October 9, 2026.
market_context_summary: U.S. equities were slipping from records as Brent crude moved above $104 and the 10-year Treasury yield traded around 5.3%; the oil shock is especially adverse for DAL, while high yields pressure valuation-sensitive PKE and ODC.

top_setups.note: No second or third evidence-qualified directional setup existed on either side in this narrow window.

methodology.independence_note: Passes A, B, and C independently evaluated the same fixed universe before consensus.
methodology.disparity_definition: Average of direction-score dispersion and reversal-risk dispersion, normalized to 0-100; lower is tighter agreement.
methodology.learned_lessons_update: Applied existing timing, key-metric, priced-in, hidden-risk, and forward-look checks. No new method change was warranted.

ranked_companies.timing: Oct. 9, 2026 before market open; webcast 10:00 a.m. ET
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Demand is healthy, but the fuel shock, falling near-term EPS estimates, and a 45% one-year share-price gain leave margin and guidance vulnerable.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Current published consensus clusters near $1.94-$1.99 EPS and $17.6-$17.8B revenue versus Delta's July EPS guide of $2.00-$2.50; estimates have moved lower recently.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Premium and corporate pricing offsets fuel, and the December-quarter outlook stays constructive.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Fuel and non-fuel costs compress margin and force a softer forward outlook.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options sources imply roughly a 5%-7% move; shares are up about 45% year over year and short interest is near 4%.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q3 EPS estimates fell roughly 5.6% over one month while revenue estimates were nearly flat; three-month revisions remained positive.

pass_outputs.key_metric: Unit revenue less fuel and CASM pressure

ranked_companies.timing: Oct. 8, 2026 after market close; call 5:00 p.m. ET
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: GE-engine program growth and a strong Q1 support another operating beat, but a premium valuation and known Q2 guide sharply raise the bar.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Management guided Q2 sales to $19.5M-$21.0M and adjusted EBITDA to $4.3M-$5.1M; market revenue consensus is about $20.0M and EPS consensus about $0.16.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: GE program sales reach the top of plan and 30%+ gross-margin quality holds.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Freight or supply constraints push EBITDA below the range while valuation compresses.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Reliable event-implied move was unavailable; the prior report gained 7.4%, but shares later drifted 16.2% lower and remain up roughly 47% year over year.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Sparse coverage; available consensus centers near management's revenue range rather than implying a large beat.

ranked_companies.timing: Oct. 8, 2026 after market close; webcast Oct. 9 at 10:00 a.m. CT
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Thin consensus; cost inflation; high bar
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record Q3 sales and June price increases support upside, but cost-per-ton inflation, weak year-to-date profit conversion, and missing consensus leave no durable edge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: No reliable Q4 EPS or revenue consensus is available; the market is likely to compare margin conversion against Q3's 9% sales growth, 23% operating-income growth, and only 2% gross-profit growth.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Price increases catch up to costs and strong retail demand converts into margin expansion.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Backlog timing unwinds and manufacturing inflation again absorbs revenue growth.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable event-implied move; shares are up about 45% year over year after a 17.4% prior earnings jump, increasing sell-the-news risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: No usable upcoming quarterly revision series; this materially lowers evidence quality.

detailed_company_sections.consensus_summary: All three passes leaned down; scores ranged from -34 to -43 and reversal risk from 55 to 60.
detailed_company_sections.one_sentence_thesis: Demand is healthy, but the fuel shock, falling near-term EPS estimates, and a 45% one-year share-price gain leave margin and guidance vulnerable.
detailed_company_sections.what_the_market_expects: About $1.94-$1.99 EPS and $17.6-$17.8B revenue, with roughly a 5%-7% options move.
detailed_company_sections.what_could_make_stock_go_up: Premium/corporate demand and pricing offset fuel; the forward margin guide holds.
detailed_company_sections.what_could_make_stock_go_down: Fuel and non-fuel costs push margin below the 11%-13% July guide and management cuts the outlook.
detailed_company_sections.reversal_risk_assessment: Moderate. The bar has fallen, valuation is only about 13x forward earnings, and strong demand could trigger relief upside.
detailed_company_sections.reddit_social_or_consumer_sentiment_read: Customer discussion shows fare-price frustration, but that can also indicate pricing power; it received minimal weight.
detailed_company_sections.options_or_positioning_read: A 5%-7% implied move is meaningful; the 45% one-year run raises the hurdle, while 4% short interest is not an extreme squeeze setup.
detailed_company_sections.analyst_and_estimate_revision_read: One-month EPS revisions are negative, but three-month revenue and EPS revisions remain positive, creating a moving and two-sided bar.
detailed_company_sections.base_case: Margin misses the old guide modestly and shares fall inside the implied band.
detailed_company_sections.bull_case: Pricing power offsets fuel and the forward outlook stays intact, producing relief upside.
detailed_company_sections.bear_case: A larger margin miss plus guide cut sends the stock beyond the implied range.
detailed_company_sections.allocation_view_rationale: Excluded because reversal risk of 58 exceeds the 40 ceiling.
detailed_company_sections.disparity_effect_on_conviction: Low disparity supports consistency, but reversal risk still prevents allocation.

detailed_company_sections.consensus_summary: All three passes leaned up; scores ranged from +31 to +40 and reversal risk from 48 to 54.
detailed_company_sections.one_sentence_thesis: GE-engine program growth and a strong Q1 support another operating beat, but a premium valuation and known Q2 guide sharply raise the bar.
detailed_company_sections.what_the_market_expects: Roughly $20.0M revenue and $0.16 EPS, aligned with management's $19.5M-$21.0M sales guide.
detailed_company_sections.what_could_make_stock_go_up: GE-engine revenue approaches the high end and EBITDA margin stays near Q1's 25%.
detailed_company_sections.what_could_make_stock_go_down: A merely in-line quarter, logistics drag, or softer forward commentary exposes the 46x trailing multiple.
detailed_company_sections.reversal_risk_assessment: Moderate. The quarter can be operationally solid yet sell off if it only meets a well-telegraphed range.
detailed_company_sections.reddit_social_or_consumer_sentiment_read: No reliable 7/14/30-day retail-sentiment signal was found; no score weight.
detailed_company_sections.options_or_positioning_read: No dependable implied move; the prior earnings jump and subsequent 16% drift show strong two-way event sensitivity.
detailed_company_sections.analyst_and_estimate_revision_read: Sparse analyst coverage and consensus close to company guidance limit the usefulness of surprise estimates.
detailed_company_sections.base_case: Results land in the upper half of guidance and shares rise modestly.
detailed_company_sections.bull_case: GE program strength and 30%+ gross margin drive an upside beat and raise.
detailed_company_sections.bear_case: Supply or freight friction pulls EBITDA below guidance and valuation compresses.
detailed_company_sections.allocation_view_rationale: Excluded because reversal risk of 51 exceeds 40 despite an absolute score above 30.
detailed_company_sections.disparity_effect_on_conviction: Low disparity improves conviction quality, but not enough for allocation.
